messages:
sahil: Opening follow-up thread for the multi-region outage postmortem. Goal: assign owners, timelines, and quick mitigations for vendor/cloud/model-registry/auth dependencies. Reply with ack + ETA.

maria: Ack. I'll lead model-registry geo-replication (metadata + blob sync). Will share design doc by Tue and PoC in next sprint.

alex: Taking auth-provider resilience. Plan: implement a short-lived token bridge and cached JWKS; PoC by Fri EOD, tests next week. Will coordinate client library changes.

anne: I'll own vendor engagement / SLA updates. Drafting emergency escalation clause and AE request. Target: vendor legal + CS draft by Wed.

julie: For model fallback behavior: ops wants automatic fallback to onboarded local quantized variant for user routes. Ops, confirm acceptable SLA impact.

ops-oncall: Auto fallback OK for public routes as long as we keep circuit-breaker thresholds conservative (5 failures / 1m -> trip, 5m cooldown) and add an alert. We'll add a synthetic cross-region healthcheck too.

sahil: Sounds good. I'll document the fallback policy (auto for public, manual for admin-only). Also adding requirement: metric to track fallback rate and successful/failed fallback percentage.

devops-bot: Created tasks:
```
INF-3390 replicate-registry-meta-eu-west-2 (assignee: maria)
INF-3391 auth-token-bridge + cached-jwks (assignee: alex)
INF-3392 update-vendor-runbook-and-slas (assignee: anne)
INF-3393 cross-region-synthetics + grafana-panel (assignee: ops-oncall)
```
Links: https://jira.redwoodinfra/INF-3391

maria: Implementation note: we'll add a versioned checksum field to metadata and backfill for recent objects. Design doc will include rollback plan and read-only secondary until sync completes.

alex: Security note: fallback tokens should be signed by our KMS and include fallback_reason claim. Avoid storing vendor private keys. Sketching code snippet now.

julie: I'll prepare a packaging checklist for the local quantized model: container size limit, cold-start time, and latency SLAs. Also QA tests for hallucination regressions.

ops-oncall: Scheduling a DR drill to exercise cross-region failover + model fallback next Tue 09:00 PT. Please RSVP. Will run synthetic scenarios: vendor auth down, region network partition, model-registry read errors.

anne: Vendor update: got verbal commitment for a dedicated AE. Legal reviewed emergency clause and suggested minor edits; will submit final wording to sales by Wed.

sahil: Action summary: maria (INF-3390), alex (INF-3391), anne (INF-3392), ops-oncall (INF-3393), julie (fallback packaging). Weekly progress updates in Jira; escalate blockers in this thread before infra sync.

devops-bot: Reminder: recurring monthly "dependency outage pattern review" added to infra-retro calendar. Ticket INF-3394.

maria: RSVP'd for DR drill and will demo small replication PoC there.

alex: Starting PoC work for INF-3391, will post initial diff and tests in thread when ready.

julie: Adding metric request: auth_fallback_rate and fallback_success_ratio to alerting playbook.

ops-oncall: Added metrics to INF-3393 checklist and will wire alerts in staging.

sahil: Thanks everyone. I'll post daily short status notes until PoCs land. Reopen thread if any vendor blockers surface.
